model_annotations.Bulgarian: Диаграмата е стълбовидна, показваща точността (%) на различни модели в три категории: Mathverse, MMLU и Physics, като всяка категория съдържа пет групирирани стълба, представляващи методите DAPO+Selection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection и SRPO. По хоризонталната ос са изброени трите категории – Mathverse, MMLU и Physics – в този ред, а вертикалната ос показва точността в проценти, с диапазон от 50 до 62, разделяна на интервали от 2 единици. Всеки стълб е със специфичен визуален образ: DAPO+Selection е със синьо изпълнение, GRPO – с оранжево с хоризонтални линии, DAPO – със сиво с вертикални линии, PPO+Self-reflection – със зелено със скосени линии, а SRPO – със светло зелено с хоризонтални линии. В легендата са посочени всички пет метода, като всеки е свързан със съответния визуален стил. В категорията Mathverse най-високият стълб е за SRPO, достигащ около 55.8%, докато най-ниският е за DAPO, около 53.1%. В MMLU най-високият стълб е за DAPO+Selection, около 57.0%, а най-ниският е за PPO+Self-reflection, около 54.5%. В категорията Physics най-високият стълб е за DAPO+Selection, достигащ около 61.2%, а най-ниският е за PPO, около 57.0%. Стълбовете във всяка категория са подредени в същия ред на методите, както е посочено в легендата.
model_annotations.Chinese: The bar chart displays the accuracy percentages of five different methods—DAPO+Selection, GRPO, DAPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three distinct domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The horizontal axis categorizes the data by domain, with the labels arranged from left to right as Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with major tick marks at intervals of 2%. Each domain contains a group of five bars, each corresponding to one of the methods and distinguished by a unique pattern and color: DAPO+Selection (solid blue), GRPO (diagonal orange stripes), DAPO (diagonal light blue stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and SRPO (diagonal green stripes). The legend is located in the top-left corner, associating each method with its respective bar style. Within the Mathverse group, the DAPO method has the highest accuracy (approximately 53.2%), followed by DAPO+Selection (approximately 56.2%), GRPO (approximately 53.5%), SRPO (approximately 55.8%), and PPO+Self-reflection (approximately 54.5%). In the MMLU group, DAPO+Selection has the highest accuracy (approximately 57.0%), followed by SRPO (approximately 57.2%), GRPO (approximately 55.8%), DAPO (approximately 55.8%), and PPO+Self-reflection (approximately 56.2%). In the Physics group, DAPO+Selection has the highest accuracy (approximately 61.0%), followed by SRPO (approximately 60.5%), GRPO (approximately 58.2%), DAPO (approximately 57.5%), and PPO+Self-reflection (approximately 59.2%). The bars are grouped by domain, and the chart shows that the accuracy of all methods generally increases from Mathverse to MMLU to Physics. The tallest bar in the chart is DAPO+Selection in the Physics domain, and the shortest bar is DAPO in the Mathverse domain.
model_annotations.English: The bar chart compares the accuracy (%) of four different methods—DAPO+Selection, GRPO, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO—across three domains: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics. The vertical axis represents accuracy in percentage, ranging from 50% to 62%, with major gridlines at 52%, 54%, 56%, 58%, and 60%. The horizontal axis lists the three domains. For each domain, four bars are grouped together, with colors and patterns corresponding to the methods as defined in the legend: DAPO+Selection (blue solid), GRPO (orange with diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (green with diagonal stripes), and SRPO (light blue with vertical stripes). In Mathverse, DAPO+Selection achieves approximately 56.2%, GRPO is around 54.1%, PPO+Self-reflection is about 54.8%, and SRPO is approximately 53.2%. In MMLU, DAPO+Selection is around 57.2%, GRPO is about 55.9%, PPO+Self-reflection is approximately 56.5%, and SRPO is around 55.8%. In Physics, DAPO+Selection reaches the highest accuracy at about 62.1%, GRPO is approximately 58.5%, PPO+Self-reflection is around 59.5%, and SRPO is about 57.2%. Overall, DAPO+Selection achieves the highest accuracy in all three domains, while SRPO consistently has the lowest accuracy.
model_annotations.German: Das Balkendiagramm zeigt die Genauigkeit in Prozent für verschiedene Modelle, die auf drei verschiedenen Datensätzen – Mathverse, MMLU und Physics – getestet wurden. Die horizontale Achse repräsentiert die drei Datensätze, während die vertikale Achse die Genauigkeit in Prozent von 50 bis 62 anzeigt, mit einem Tick-Intervall von 1. Für jeden Datensatz sind fünf gruppierte Balken dargestellt, die jeweils einem Modell entsprechen: DAPO+Selection (blauer Balken mit diagonalen Streifen), GRPO (orange Balken mit diagonalen Streifen), DAPO (hellblauer Balken mit diagonalen Streifen), PPO+Self-reflection (grüner Balken mit diagonalen Streifen) und SRPO (oranger Balken mit diagonalen Streifen). Die Balken sind in jeder Gruppe nebeneinander angeordnet, wobei die Reihenfolge der Modelle innerhalb jeder Gruppe aus der Legende abgeleitet wird. Die Balkenlängen variieren je nach Modell und Datensatz, wobei der höchste Balken bei Physics für DAPO+Selection eine Genauigkeit von etwa 61 % erreicht und der niedrigste Balken bei Mathverse für DAPO eine Genauigkeit von etwa 53 % zeigt. Die Balken sind nicht alphabetisch oder nach Genauigkeit sortiert, sondern folgen der Reihenfolge der Datensätze auf der horizontalen Achse. Keine Balken sind visuell hervorgehoben.
